explication: Claude Octopus is a Claude Code plugin for escalating work into multi-provider research, implementation, and review, with consensus gates; its README also describes memory integrations, engineering workflows, and autonomous Dark Factory runs. The supplied source excerpts expose the MCP entry point and a separate design-token extraction pipeline, plus UI/UX search and design-system tools. The tree omits the main orchestration script and many workflow assets, so those branches reflect README claims only; connections are shown only where documented or indexed.
